items.title: 31.2 Toxicity and Recycling in Material Science

source_refs.note: Topic 31.2 heading (PDF 221); the book gives no text under the heading, so the lesson gives a short overview of its subtopics.

blocks.text: Materials that make modern life possible can also cause harm. This section looks at how materials can be toxic during their production, use and disposal (31.2.1), at two major groups of toxic materials, heavy metals and plastics (31.2.2), and at recycling, which saves resources and energy but faces technical and economic challenges (31.2.3).
